title: Can an AI Agent Call Law Firm Leads? Rule 7.3 Asks Who Started the Call
meta_description: Read on 28 September 2026: ABA Model Rule 7.3 bans live person-to-person solicitation, and Texas 7.03 names any electronically interactive contact made on a lawyer’s behalf. Where an AI intake agent may call, and where it may only text.
primary_keyword: ai intake law firm solicitation rules
secondary_keywords: can a law firm use ai to call leads
law firm speed to lead ethics
ai receptionist for law firms solicitation

image.takeaway: A callback to a request is not a solicitation. A first AI call to a stranger who needs a lawyer is.
